2-2-1-3 Technical Director(Continued)

The technical director will be responsible for all technical work, which would include sceneries and art work needed on plays (all school productions) and for any work needed for special auditoriums and other events in the auditorium. This job will cover the entire year. The stage director will be responsible for the training of students to act as stage managers and light managers and would also be responsible for the care of all stage equipment and tools and would be on call for any equipment needed for plays or special auditoriums.
